body.x: At CES 2023, Simple Labs premiered its Cogni™ Wine Barrel Monitor - the barrel monitoring system designed to simplify the winemaking process, and a CES® 2023 Innovation Awards Honoree in the Food & Ag Tech category. Simple Labs exhibited at CES 2023 within CES Tech West in the Venetian Expo Level 2 Food Expo, Booth #53514.

Simple Labs stated that Cogni™ is a patented, wireless, continuous, integrated barrel aging monitoring system. They developed this device that can track temperature, humidity, phenol/guaiacol, acetic acid, SO2, pH, alcohol, and fill levels of a barrel. It sends real-time data and alerts accessible to winemakers from anywhere worldwide via mobile and desktop notifications. Winemakers can utilize a network of multiple Cogni devices with any number of barrels and review the current levels and recorded data before the decisions.

body.x: "Of great benefit to wineries is the ability to immediately extract data from anywhere in the world, creating the ability to detect potential problems in the winemaking process before an issue occurs, as well as opportunities to better take care of wines in barrel." Mike Slone, Simple Labs Founder, and CEO - also the inventor of Cogni - said, "In addition to optimizing the winemaking process, there are also labor cost savings in the cellar and savings in terms of sending samples out to an exterior lab."

body.x: Simple Labs™ is a technology company dedicated to processing the production of goods created with barrels. The company aims to deliver clarity to winemakers and vineyards during barrel aging by creating innovative technological solutions based on ever-changing challenges and needs. Simple Labs stated that it globally and equally supports all winemakers regardless of scale, funding in an immersive understanding of customer needs to offer a personalized experience. It continued that the creativity and innovation of the company arise from deep roots in diversity and a collection of equally-heard voices in the room, actions, and causes. It underlined the company's tenets - emotional intelligence, social and environmental awareness, genuine curiosity, and kindness filled with empathy.
